disqualifier.note: Independent UI axes: disabled is the shared actions-closed gate (resolved, review waiting, or detail refresh); selected is whether this proposal is the current review target. Combined-true is written when a selected proposal stays highlighted while actionsDisabled is true.

Independent facts on one evidence row: verified-anchor presence vs whether this row is the selected source. Combined-true is the inspectable selected source; unverified+selected still renders a disabled button.

Independent disable reasons OR'd into actionsDisabled: detail-refresh waiting, a settled disposition, and an in-flight review AsyncResult. Combined-true is legal (refresh after a recorded decision) and is a priority gate over free combinations.
Independent length predicates over one reason string, OR'd into reasonInvalid. Readers match reasonTooLong alone for copy; they never exclusive-write or exclusive-read the pair as a masked union.
